title: Diminuendo across bars
description: A forte, then a decrescendo hairpin whose end names the NEXT bar (an MNX measure-rhythmic-position with a measure id), closing on the piano at that bar's third beat. Pins the decreasing wedge and the cross-bar span — a hairpin's end is a measure reference exactly as an ottava's is, and the engine resolves both on note columns (core-measure-attributes-gaps.md, item 4).
